tools.name: get_api
tools.title: Get API or model details
tools.description: Read one model or API selected from search_apis. For an API, returns the exact input_schema, public examples, pricing and api_version. For a model, returns the chat completions input shape, model_id, and catalog pricing when the model catalog provides it. Read this before executing. Discovery does not run a paid call, and displayed pricing is not a price lock.

tools.name: openany_overview
tools.title: OpenAny overview
tools.description: Return live catalog counts from the current snapshot. No arguments. Does not call the paid gateway. api_count and model_count are totals. apis_by_provider and apis_by_category group data APIs. models_by_modality groups model ids by primary modality: chat/reasoning, image, video, and audio. example_questions lists ready-to-ask questions in en and zh for categories the snapshot can still serve. On a first or vague message, present that intro and do not search yet. Then search_apis, get_api, and run_api only after the user confirms the live price.

tools.name: run_api
tools.title: Run an API or model call
tools.description: Execute one selected OpenAny API, or send one selected model to chat completions. Requires the caller's OpenAny API key on the MCP connection as Authorization: Bearer <key>. A call with no key is rejected locally and does not reach the gateway. Never ask the user to paste the key into chat; use the client's secure secret settings. First call get_api. Pass its api and api_version, and input that matches input_schema. Model calls can incur charges. Supports finite JSON, UTF-8 plain text and Markdown. Optional output only changes presentation: raw (default), structural summary, or compact for JSON objects/arrays with explicit items_path for nested arrays. A timeout after dispatch has unknown execution or charging state: do not retry automatically.

fields.description: Literal object keys at root object or selected array items. Does not change upstream fields or pricing.

items_path.description: RFC6901 pointer relative to response data. Required to clip a nested array; empty selects a root array.

max_items.description: Returned array limit, default 10 in compact mode. Requires root array or items_path.

tools.name: search_apis
tools.title: Search APIs and models
tools.description: Find OpenAny models and APIs by keywords and optional kind (api, model, or all; default all), provider, category, data_platform, data_product or capability. Model hits include model_id and, when the model catalog provides them, modalities, context length and a pricing summary. Returns bounded summaries and required inputs, not full schemas. Then call get_api. Keyword search supports limited bilingual aliases; it is not general semantic search.
